assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: standalone photographic website image for a premium independent IT support business, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: A front-on beautifully photographed silver desktop monitor and compact silver laptop standing physically on a white seamless desk. The equipment has restrained modern industrial design with no visible brands. A slim keyboard rests in front, a small neutral white router nearby, and just a minimal small green plant clipped by one edge of the frame. Both displays show only a subtle pale blue-gray abstract wallpaper, no application windows or webpages.
Scene/backdrop: luminous white and pale cool-gray studio with real grounded equipment, uncluttered and spacious.
Style/medium: exquisitely realistic premium product photography, precise material detail and natural proportions, refined catalog quality.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, eye-level front-on camera, full main equipment visible, generous clear margins, subtle grounded shadows on the clean desk.
Lighting/mood: large soft studio light, bright airy exposure, gentle highlights on aluminum, calm and elegant.
Constraints: A single photographic scene, no collage, no text, no UI labels, no logos, no watermark. Equipment must stand on the desk. Avoid floating objects, neon, black backgrounds, glowing cyber effects, generic AI technology art.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: standalone photographic website image for premium independent home Wi-Fi support, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: A beautifully photographed clean white compact Wi-Fi mesh router standing on a light oak sideboard in an airy bright contemporary real home interior. The router is a modest rounded rectangular object with subtle believable material texture, no logos and no visible branding.
Scene/backdrop: quiet light neutral home, pale walls, natural light softly entering the room, restrained neutral furnishing softly out of focus. Abundant uncluttered negative space around the router.
Style/medium: refined editorial interior and product photography, very realistic grounded equipment in a believable lived-in modern home, soft tactile materials.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, router clearly visible with clean silhouette, modest eye-level three-quarter view, spacious composition and gentle background depth, usable as a service-card photo.
Lighting/mood: bright natural daylight, warm oak accents, luminous whites and pale cool gray, calm premium feel.
Constraints: Single photographic scene. No text, UI labels, logos, watermark, people or floating objects. No illustrated Wi-Fi signal rings, no neon, no fantasy technology, no advertising graphics.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: standalone photographic website image for premium independent computer support, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: Close crop of adult hands naturally using a silver laptop on a clean light-colored desk. One hand is positioned comfortably on the trackpad and the other near the keyboard in a believable working posture. The silver laptop screen shows a soft out-of-focus neutral settings window with simple pale rows, with no readable text. No faces or identifying person details are visible.
Scene/backdrop: a bright uncluttered real work area, pale cool gray and off-white surfaces.
Style/medium: exquisitely realistic editorial photography, natural skin texture, anatomically plausible hands, believable technique and laptop construction, refined and understated.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, cropped to hands, forearms and laptop, gentle three-quarter angle from beside the user, keyboard and trackpad clearly grounded in the scene, screen softly out of focus.
Lighting/mood: soft warm natural daylight, subtle shadows, luminous and reassuring premium visual tone.
Constraints: One photographic scene, no faces, no identifiable person, no text overlays, no readable UI labels, no logos, no watermarks. No floating equipment, neon or generic AI tech imagery. This is generic illustrative equipment photography.
